name: ForceDimension
description: Force Dimension is a robotics company founded in 2001 in Nyon, Switzerland, as a spin-off from the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne (EPFL). The company designs and manufactures parallel-kinematic delta haptic master interfaces—including the [omega.x](/robot/force_dimension_omega), [sigma.7](/robot/force_dimension_sigma), and [lambda.7](/robot/force_dimension_lambda) series—integrated as OEM master controllers in surgical consoles from [Virtual Incision](/company/virtual_incision) ([MIRA](/robot/virtual_incision_mira)), [RIVERFIELD](/company/riverfield) ([Saroa](/robot/riverfield_saroa)), [EndoQuest Robotics](/company/endoquest_robotics) ([ELS](/robot/endoquest_els)), [Endomaster](/company/endomaster) ([EASE](/robot/endomaster_ease)), and [Applied Dexterity](/company/applied_dexterity) ([Raven-II](/robot/raven_II)).
